description.default: Export a SiYuan document tree to a standardized .docx inside the browser: built-in headings with auto numbering, three-line tables, captions as SEQ fields, cross-references as REF fields, Zotero citations and bibliography as fields, images truly embedded, empty tables preserved, one page per document.
description.zh_CN: 把思源文档树导出为规范 .docx（纯前端完成）：内置标题与自动编号、三线表、题注 SEQ 域、交叉引用 REF 域、Zotero 引用与书目域、图片真嵌入、空表完整保留、每篇文档另起一页。
